fact: 1923年7月24日，《洛桑条约》签署，取代1920年《色佛尔条约》，土耳其国家的主权获得国际承认，作为奥斯曼帝国的合法继承国。10月4日，最后一批协约国军队撤离伊斯坦布尔，协约国对土耳其的占领结束。10月29日，土耳其共和国在新首都安卡拉正式宣告成立，穆斯塔法·凯末尔当选首任总统。

sources.title: NZHistory, The Birth of the Republic of Turkey, 1920-23
sources.quote: The Treaty of Lausanne was signed on 24 July 1923. On 13 October Ankara officially became the capital of the new Turkish state. On 29 October a republic was proclaimed, with Mustafa Kemal as its first president.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Turkey
sources.quote: The Treaty of Lausanne of 24 July 1923, which superseded the Treaty of Sèvres, led to the international recognition of the sovereignty of the Turkish state as the successor state of the Ottoman Empire. On 4 October 1923, the Allied occupation of Turkey ended with the withdrawal of the last Allied troops from Istanbul. The Turkish Republic was officially proclaimed on 29 October 1923 in Ankara, the country's new capital.

fact: 1922年11月1日，安卡拉的大国民议会正式废除苏丹制，终结了623年的奥斯曼君主统治。末代苏丹穆罕默德六世在家人的陪同下寻求英国军事当局庇护，后被秘密带出伊斯坦布尔，最终流亡意大利圣雷莫，1926年在那里去世。1923年10月13日安卡拉正式成为新首都。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Turkey
sources.quote: On 1 November 1922, the Turkish Parliament in Ankara formally abolished the Sultanate, thus ending 623 years of monarchical Ottoman rule. ... The Turkish Republic was officially proclaimed on 29 October 1923 in Ankara, the country's new capital.

sources.title: NZHistory, The Birth of the Republic of Turkey
sources.quote: Turkey's Grand National Assembly abolished the Sultanate on 1 November 1922. Mehmed VI and his family sought refuge with the British military authorities in Istanbul. They were smuggled out of the city and eventually went into exile in San Remo, Italy, where the former monarch would die in 1926.

fact: 《洛桑条约》规定希腊与土耳其之间的人口交换：约110万名希腊正教徒离开土耳其前往希腊，约38万名穆斯林从希腊移居土耳其。人口交换对两国的商业网络、地产所有权和社区结构造成深远影响。

sources.title: Wikiwand，土耳其共和国
sources.quote: 《洛桑條約》亦規定了希臘和土耳其的人口交換,110萬名希臘人離開土耳其前往希臘,而380,000名穆斯林則由希臘來到土耳其。

fact: 1923年8月，土耳其人民共和党（CHP）成立，凯末尔任主席，成为新共和国的执政核心。凯末尔随后推行一系列激进改革，目标是把旧的宗教为基础的多族群奥斯曼君主制转变为世俗议会制共和国：废除哈里发制（1924年3月3日）、禁戴费兹帽（1925年帽法）、采用拉丁字母（1928年）、采用瑞士民法（1926年）。

sources.title: Wikipedia, History of Turkey
sources.quote: Mustafa Kemal became the republic's first president and introduced many reforms. The reforms aimed to transform the old religion-based and multi-communal Ottoman monarchy into a Turkish nation state that would be governed as a parliamentary republic under a secular constitution. ... The abolition of the caliphate followed on 3 March 1924. In the same year, Turkey abolished sharia and in 1925, a clothing reform for men (the Hat Law) was enacted. In 1926, Swiss civil law—and thus monogamy with the equality of men and women—was adopted first.

fact: 安卡拉从安纳托利亚内陆小城一跃成为新首都，大量政府机构、外交使团和商人从伊斯坦布尔迁入，带动房价和生活成本急剧上升。伊斯坦布尔作为前帝国首都仍保持商业中心地位，但政治重心已转移到安卡拉。人口交换导致两地人口结构剧变，希腊正教商人和工匠大量离开。

sources.title: Wikipedia, History of Turkey
sources.quote: The fez was banned, full rights for women politically were established, and new alphabet for Turkish based upon the Latin script was created. Among the other things, economic privileges for foreigners were abolished and their means of production and railways were nationalised. Foreign schools were placed under state control.

fact: 凯末尔改革逐步废除外国人的经济特权（ capitulations ），铁路被国有化，外国学校被置于国家控制之下。1923年后土耳其的法律体系逐步从伊斯兰教法转向欧洲大陆法系：1926年采用瑞士民法（确立一夫一妻制和男女平等）、德国商法、意大利刑法。地产过户和商业登记的法律环境在1923—1926年间剧烈变动。

sources.title: Wikipedia, History of Turkey
sources.quote: Among the other things, economic privileges for foreigners were abolished and their means of production and railways were nationalised. Foreign schools were placed under state control. ... In 1926, Swiss civil law—and thus monogamy with the equality of men and women—was adopted first (gender equality was only partially achieved in everyday life, however), so polygamy was banned. This was followed by German commercial law and Italian criminal law.

fact: 奥斯曼帝国遗留的货币体系在共和国初期继续使用，土耳其里拉（基于奥斯曼里拉）在1923年后逐步重估。旧帝国的国债（奥斯曼国债）在新共和国的法律地位不确定。外国资本在1923年后面临经济特权被取消的政策环境，但短期内在伊斯坦布尔的金融基础设施（银行、交易所）仍由外国和少数族裔机构主导。

fact: 安卡拉作为新首都的城市建设在1923年后迅速展开：政府大楼、外交使团、铁路连接（安卡拉—伊斯坦布尔铁路是新首都的生命线）和市政基础设施建设是最初的产业风口。1927年《工业激励法》通过，1934年第一个工业五年计划生效，标志着土耳其从农业国向工业化的起步。
